comingLast.roast: finished on 18 - the bravest thing now is staying for the presentation
escape number: 2. holes remaining: 4. belief in the clubhouse: modest.
on 17 at 1.3 - his playing partners are witnesses now, not opponents
at 1.3 a hole the blue balls fit like they were measured for him
2 above Elliott - the kind of lead that keeps a man honest
2 clear, 4 to play - the great escape is still escapable
3 above the blue ball line with 3 in hand - keep scoring, keep breathing
4 clear at 1.5 a hole - survival golf, played survivally
4 from the double blue - a wipe here would be extremely on-brand
cushion of 5 over Elliott - the bar has him at even money
